import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
s='''module
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Nlinarith
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Omega
@[expose] public section
namespace URMatching
/-- The integer cross-multiplied geometric bound for sampling without replacement.
This is the one-colour falling-product estimate, without division or rounding. -/
theorem avoidance_product_bound (N b a : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ N - b)
    (hb : b ≤ N) (hquarter : N ≤ 4 * b) :
    4 ^ a * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range a, (N - b - i)) ≤
      3 ^ a * (∏ i ∈ Finset.range a, (N - i)) := by
  have hf : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range a, 4 * (N - b - i) ≤ 3 * (N - i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i < a := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hbi : b + i ≤ N := by omega
    have hni : i ≤ N := by omega
    have e₁ : N - b - i + b + i = N := by omega
    have e₂ : N - i + i = N := by omega
    nlinarith
  have h := Finset.prod_le_prod' hf
  simpa only [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range] using h
end URMatching
'''
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingAvoidanceProduct.lean'],input=s,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode)
